import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess,sys,json,base64
from pathlib import Path
writer=str(Path('write_lane.py').resolve())
def save(n,s,b=False):
 r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',writer,n]+(['--base64'] if b else []),input=s,text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
for page in [4,5,6,8,17,19]:
 r=subprocess.run(['pdftoppm','-f',str(page),'-l',str(page),'-scale-to','1300','-singlefile','-png','inputs/sources/cactus.pdf'],capture_output=True,timeout=20);assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr;save(f'figures/primary-p{page}.png',base64.b64encode(r.stdout).decode(),True)
queries=['"Randić index, radius, and diameter for cactus graphs" Doig journal correction','"cactus" "longitudinally symmetric" Randic','"2107.00071" proof conjecture ratio github']
save('search-plan-1.json',json.dumps({'call':1,'queries':queries,'purpose':'Exact primary final/history, symmetry definition and public proof counterpart discovery'},indent=2))
b=json.loads(Path('search-budget.json').read_text());assert b['calls_used']==0;b.update(calls_used=1,queries_used=3);save('search-budget.json',json.dumps(b,indent=2))
print('Rendered primary pages 4,5,6,8,17,19; search 1 precharged 3 queries.')
